chunks: And from him, from al-Qasim, from Aban, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Abdillah, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
Regarding a man who buys a female slave who has not yet menstruated or whose menstruation has ceased, what is her waiting period? He said: 'Five and forty nights.'
ai.seo_question: What is the waiting period for a female slave who has not yet menstruated?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* specifies the *iddah* (waiting period) for a female slave who is either pre-pubescent or post-menopausal, establishing it as forty-five nights to confirm her fertility status and lineage. In Shia jurisprudence, this period serves as a safeguard for determining paternity should she become pregnant, reflecting the practical legal needs of the time regarding slave ownership and inheritance. The ruling highlights the distinction between menstrual-based and age-based *iddah* calculations in classical fiqh.
